items.title: 61520_Teddy Edwards oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I saw Pete Daley there. [INTERVIEWEE] Pete Daley, yeah.

ctx.x: Pete Daley, yeah. And that's where I first heard Ernie Caceres, the great baritone saxophone player. In fact, he seemed to be more advanced musically than the other guys that he was playing with. That's how he really impressed me when I heard him play, you know.
